name: caller-tool-never-executes
description: A caller tool is vocabulary, never capability: there is no code path from the request's tool list to the execution registry. The model names the caller's tool and the agent performs nothing - the run pauses instead of chasing an unknown word or running something the deployment never configured.

callerTools.name: send_email
callerTools.description: Sends an email from the caller's own outbox.
